tai-khoan-ai.title: AI assistant
tai-khoan-ai.description: Add your own AI key to use your personal Chuyện Nhỏ assistant.

settings.title: Your <accent>AI</accent> assistant
settings.intro: The assistant runs on your own AI key: usage is billed to your AI account and Chuyện Nhỏ adds no charge. The key is encrypted on the AI server; Chuyện Nhỏ does not keep it.
settings.unavailable: AI is not switched on on the server yet. Please come back later.

provider.title: AI key
provider.text: Pick a provider, paste your API key and choose a model. The assistant sends one short greeting to test the key (a few tokens).
provider.apiBaseHelp: Change it only for another OpenAI-compatible service (must be https://).
provider.apiKeyHelp: The key only goes to the AI server, which stores it encrypted; this page never shows it again.
provider.apiKeyReplace: Paste a new key to replace the current one.
provider.modelManual: Not in the list? Type the model name
provider.modelHelp: The list comes from the provider, using your key.
provider.noModels: The provider returned no model list. Type the model name.
provider.verified: The key works. Your assistant is ready.
provider.removeConfirm: Remove your AI key? The assistant stops at once; your chat history is kept.
provider.disabled: The AI assistant of this account is suspended. Please contact contact@lpc.vn.

card.title: AI assistant
card.text: A personal assistant that finds the right tool, explains how to use it and looks up official rules — running on your own AI key.

invite.title: The AI assistant comes with Pro
invite.text: A personal assistant on your own AI key (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic…): ask which tool to use, how to do it, and where the official rules are.
invite.guest: Sign in to see the Pro plan.

chat.title: Chuyện Nhỏ assistant
chat.placeholder: What do you need to do? For example: shrink a PDF to email it
chat.emptyText: It finds the right Chuyện Nhỏ tool, walks you through it and looks up official sources.
chat.sendFailed: Your message was not sent. Please try again.
chat.loadFailed: This conversation could not be opened.
chat.disclaimer: Answers are AI-generated and unverified. Check the sources before relying on them.
chat.notReadyText: Add an AI key and check it to turn the assistant on.

errors.SIGNED_OUT: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.PRO_REQUIRED: The AI assistant is part of Pro.
errors.UNTRUSTED_REQUEST: Invalid request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Something is not right. Check the key and the model.
errors.INVALID_API_BASE: That API address cannot be used (it must be a public https:// server).
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: AI is not switched on on the server.
errors.AI_UPSTREAM: The AI server is busy or not answering. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.AI_VERIFY_FAILED: The key or model does not work yet.
errors.AI_NOT_READY: The assistant is not ready. Check your AI key again.
errors.AI_DISABLED: The AI assistant of this account is suspended.
errors.NETWORK: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This draft is gone (already sent or discarded).
errors.DUPLICATE_CONTRIBUTION: This proposal is already waiting for review.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You have sent too many proposals. Try again in an hour.

sourceCheck.title: AI source check
sourceCheck.text: Your assistant uses your own AI key to find the latest official text and compare it with the figures this tool uses. Every change is only a draft: you pick the rows to send, and Chuyện Nhỏ reviewers check them before anything is applied.
sourceCheck.inviteText: Pro members can ask their AI assistant to find the latest official text and draft an update for this tool's figures.
sourceCheck.setupText: Set up your AI key so the assistant can check sources for this tool.
sourceCheck.unavailable: AI features are not enabled on the server yet.
sourceCheck.noBasis: No verified package yet; the tool is using figures you entered.
sourceCheck.includeResultHint: The result is sent to the AI provider you set up. Emails and phone numbers are masked first.
sourceCheck.emptyText: Press “Start source check”: the assistant reads the package in use, then looks for newer official text.

message.intro: Check the rules behind the “{{tool}}” tool (toolId: {{toolId}}, domain: {{domain}}, kind: {{kinds}}).
message.snapshot: Chuyện Nhỏ uses the package effective from {{date}}, source “{{title}}”: {{url}}
message.noSnapshot: Chuyện Nhỏ has no verified package for this tool; I am entering the figures myself.
message.ask: Find the latest official text and compare every figure. If anything differs, create a draft proposal for me to review.

drafts.title: Draft proposals
drafts.hint: Written by AI and not verified. Only pick rows you have checked against the official text.
drafts.confirm: I checked the picked rows against the sources
drafts.attribution: Credit me by name when the proposal is published
drafts.removeConfirm: Discard this draft? It cannot be restored.
drafts.sent: Sent for review. Follow it in
drafts.loadFailed: Could not load the draft proposals.
